description: Look up CPAN, Perl's module archive, through MetaCPAN: search modules, get a module's latest version and documentation, a distribution's releases, dependencies, the distributions that depend on it, its Changes file, contributors, ++ votes, issue counts and known security advisories, CPAN authors and their releases, who may upload a module, and what was released recently. Start a workflow when a distribution or an author has a new release. No account or API key required.

metacpan_new_author_release_trigger.description: Runs when a CPAN author uploads a new release of any of their distributions, with its version, upload time, abstract and download link. Stable releases only unless you choose otherwise.
metacpan_new_author_release_trigger.display_name: New CPAN release by an author

output.abstract: Its one-line summary, such as 'A postmodern object system'.
output.author: The PAUSE ID of the author who uploaded it, such as 'ETHER'. 'Get an author' takes it.
output.authorized: False when the uploader had no permission for the modules it holds, so CPAN clients don't install it.
output.date: When it was uploaded to CPAN, in UTC, such as '2026-10-01T00:35:44Z'.
output.distribution: The distribution's name, such as 'Moose' or 'Try-Tiny': the package CPAN installs. Every action that takes a distribution accepts it.
output.download_url: The link to download its archive (.tar.gz).
output.first: True when this was the distribution's first release.
output.main_module: The distribution's main module, such as 'Moose'.
output.maturity: 'released' for a stable release, 'developer' for a trial release (its name ends in -TRIAL or its version has an underscore).
output.name: The release's name: the distribution and its version, such as 'Moose-2.4001'.
output.status: 'latest' for the distribution's current release, 'cpan' for an older one still on CPAN, 'backpan' for one deleted from CPAN (still on BackPAN, CPAN's history).

parameters.description: The author's PAUSE ID, such as ETHER.
